title: Game Pass: New Games Added, Price Increase & October Releases
text:
New Games ⁤Arriving on Xbox Game Pass This October include Ninja Gaiden ⁣4 adn More Xbox Game pass subscribers have a robust lineup of new titles ⁢heading their way this October, headlined by Ninja Gaiden 4 and including additions like Evil west , Ball x Pit , and Keeper . The first wave of games will begin rolling‍ out October⁤ 15th, ⁢with further additions throughout the month.
this influx of content provides significant value for Game Pass members, offering access to a diverse range of experiences across Cloud, ‍PC, and Xbox Series S/X consoles. October 15th‍ will see the arrival ​of Aiden II Black , Pax ​Dei , and Keeper . Evil West and Ninja Gaiden 4 will follow on October 21st. Beyond the‌ games themselves, subscribers will also receive benefits ‌within Valorant with the “Play the new agent veto” perk and Call of Duty: Warzone through “Game Pass Pack 4.”
October Game Pass Additions:
* ‍ Aiden ⁢II black (Cloud, PC, Xbox ‌Series S/X) – October 15
* Pax Dei (PC) – October 16
* Keeper (Cloud, PC, Xbox Series S/X) – October 17
* evil West (Cloud, Xbox, PC) – October 21
* Ninja Gaiden 4 (Cloud, PC, Xbox Series S/X) -⁣ October ⁣21
Games leaving Game Pass October 15:
* Cocoon (cloud, xbox, PC)
* Core Keeper ‍(Cloud,⁣ Xbox, PC)
* ‌ Teenage Mutant Ninja ‍Turtles: Mutants ​Unleashed (Cloud, Xbox, PC)
Subscribers⁣ can purchase these departing titles at a discounted rate before they leave the service. Further ‌details and a complete list of benefits are available on the Xbox Wire .
